description: Go language pack: creates project structure and initializes modules.

module_path.description: Module path for a newly initialized Go module (default: derived from directory name). An existing module path is never rewritten.

go_version.description: Go version for the module's go directive when set with --set. The value is written to go.mod by the Go pack; when absent, go.mod keeps the host toolchain version and CI reads it from go.mod.
